trap.label: could have vs. could
trap.wrong: I could go to the party last Saturday, but I was tired.
trap.right: I could have gone to the party last Saturday, but I was tired.
trap.why: O português usa "podia ir" para possibilidade não realizada; em inglês could go soa como habilidade geral. Use could have + particípio.

mcq.q: Qual tem sentido de possibilidade fraca?
opts: It must have been a mistake.
It might have been a mistake.

mcq.q: A negativa de "might have gone" é...

fix.wrong: They could of won the game.
fix.right: They could have won the game.

fix.wrong: He may has lost his wallet.
fix.right: He may have lost his wallet.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva na negativa: “He may have seen it.”
rewrite.answer: He may not have seen it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “They might forget.” (talvez tenham esquecido)
Reescreva com may: “She might have left.”
